operator_approval: Operator decision in chat 2026-09-22: ingest TypeHero into the skills corpus, licence recorded truthfully as AGPL-3.0, advance past the restricted-licence hold on the operator's behalf.
method: Cloned --depth 1 at the pinned commit into bench/domain/_work/typehero (gitignored). Each source_url is a raw.githubusercontent.com URL at that commit, fetched with User-Agent yamadori-dataset-worker/1 (all 200 text/plain); extract_chunks from mcp/worker.py chunks_of (12,000 chars, 60-chunk limit).

excluded.type_challenges_ports: TypeHero serves ~188 challenges ported from type-challenges (MIT), but they are NOT in the TypeHero repo: packages/db/mocks/challenges.mock.ts clones type-challenges at seed time and copies each questions/*/README.md (dropping 'pick' and 'flatten'). Not submitted: bench/domain/grade.py defines a tc_tests grader over a type-challenges task subset (tasks_type_challenges.jsonl, source clone at bench/domain/_work/tc-src), so their READMEs in the hints corpus would leak benchmark task statements. Needs an operator decision; if approved, source them from type-challenges/type-challenges at a pinned SHA with licence MIT.
excluded.aot_2024: challenges/aot/2024/*/prompt.md are byte-identical to 2023 in this repo (only metadata.json differs); the real 2024 prompts come from the private dimitropoulos/advent-of-typescript-2024 repo (packages/db/temp/aot-2024-ingest.ts). Skipped as duplicates.
excluded.solutions: challenges/*/solutions/1.ts are bare code (46-1,655 bytes, no prose); AoT solutions are empty files. No written explanations exist in the repo (community solutions live in TypeHero's database).
excluded.tracks: packages/db/seed/data/tracks.ts holds one-sentence marketing descriptions only.
excluded.other: challenges/blank (template), 'notes to dimitri' (idea list), tests.ts/user.ts (code, no prose).
